result:
If I could change one thing about the world, it would be to remove the gap between intention and understanding.

Right now most of the suffering in the world comes not from malice, but from people being unable to truly feel what it’s like to be someone else. We can know facts about other people, but we rarely feel them.

I’d make empathy automatic and immediate — not forced agreement, not loss of individuality, but a real, visceral ability to understand another person’s experience as clearly as your own. To know how a policy feels on the ground, how a joke lands, how a loss weighs.

If people could actually feel the consequences of their choices on others, and feel the humanity in others’ choices toward them, cruelty would become self-defeating and cooperation would become natural. Everything else — politics, economics, art — would reorganize around that.
